player_prompt.intro:
You are Player {player_id} in Chopsticks. On your turn, choose one of:
  + Attack:  '[attack M O]'  where M=your hand (0 or 1), O=opponent hand (0 or 1).
    - Opponent's hand count increases by your hand; if >=5, it becomes 0.
  + Split:   '[split L R]'  to redistribute your total fingers into L and R (L+R = your total).
Reply with exactly one of those commands.

invalid_move.opp_hand_dead: Letsogo la moganetši {opp_idx} le šetše le hwile.
invalid_move.split_sum: Palo ya dikarolwana tše di aroganego e swanetše go ba {total}.
invalid_move.split_no_change: Go arogana go swanetše go fetoša kabo ya gago ya seatla.
invalid_move.invalid_command: Tshoma e seng kgone. Sebelisa “[attack M O]” kana “[split L R]”.

game_action.attack: P{player_id} e tsoma P{opp_id}’s hand {opp_idx}: e ya go tloga {opp_val} go ya {new_val}.

outcome.win: Diatla ka bobedi tša lenaba di hwile.
outcome.draw: Moedi wa go retologa o fihlilwe.
